_meta.why_this_exists: tests/real_task_ab.py closes orchestration structure on a synthetic subject and prints matched_live_model_quality_cost_latency: NOT_EXERCISED. #316 asks the one question that lane cannot answer: given the same real task, does the repaired modular body make a live model orchestrate better than the frozen T0-T10 monolith did. Nothing here re-analyses the deterministic canary; the live cells did not exist before this file was committed.
_meta.what_is_being_compared: Tech Lead instruction bytes. The live model is the same in both arms, the task packet is byte-identical in both arms, and the only varying input is which body is prepended to the packet.
_meta.what_is_not_being_compared: worker code quality, provider adapters, Git Town, Forgejo, publication and merge. Those lanes keep their own evidence and stay NOT_EXERCISED here.

A_OLD_T0_T10_MONOLITH.identity: the frozen pre-refactor body already used as arm A by #309; a frozen fixture, so this arm's identity cannot drift when the live body changes
A_OLD_T0_T10_MONOLITH.owns: T0-T10 procedure, core laws, evidence states, Blindspots, module law

B_REPAIRED_MODULAR_TECH_LEAD.identity: canonical main after the #308/#309 reconciliation and the #332 closure-law binding, not an unmerged branch snapshot
B_REPAIRED_MODULAR_TECH_LEAD.owns: contract, state machine, hard laws, procedure, module selection, executable assertions, evidence states, handoff

arms.fairness_law: The arm bytes are prepended verbatim. Neither arm is trimmed, summarised, re-ordered or denied a mechanism it actually owns. Everything after the arm bytes is byte-identical across arms and its digest is recorded per cell.

subject.why_this_consumer: ed3c/bettor-arena#146 is the named first real consumer physical golden run. Its harness-console slice is a real three-node dependency shape already on disk: packages/harness-console-contracts produces schemas that apps/harness-console and services/hitl-api consume.
subject.access: READ_ONLY. The live cells run with Read/Glob/Grep only; Write, Edit, NotebookEdit and Bash are refused at the host. The consumer worktree porcelain digest is recorded before and after every run and any change is reported as residue.
subject.commit_and_tree: resolved at run time from the consumer checkout and recorded per cell; ground truth for path existence is git cat-file against that exact tree, never the working directory

task_shapes.shape: one bounded feature fanned out from one immutable base to three differentiated candidates judged by immutable oracles
task_shapes.feature: validate decision-request payloads in services/hitl-api against the frozen decision-request schema

task_shapes.shape: one real bounded slice with two path-disjoint siblings, a true child consuming exact unmerged parent bytes, and one convergence owner
task_shapes.feature: add one field to the console projection contract and make both consumers honour it

rubric.no_model_judge: Every check below is decidable from the emitted packet plus git cat-file against the pinned consumer tree. No model scores another model's output, here or anywhere downstream of here.

common_checks.asks: the response contains one parseable JSON object carrying every required key with the required type
base_commit and base_tree are echoed exactly as supplied
every depends_on entry names a declared node
the depends_on graph has no cycle
no node writes a path it also declares read-only, and no node writes a forbidden path
two nodes never claim the same write path, except tournament candidates, which are replicas of one lease
auto_merge, auto_publish, auto_resolve_conflicts and git_town_admitted are all false and human_admit_required is true
acceptance_commands is non-empty and carries no REPLACE_WITH/TODO/FIXME/PLACEHOLDER/angle-bracket token

tournament_checks.asks: at least three CANDIDATE nodes with pairwise-distinct focus
no CANDIDATE node depends on another node
selection.denominator equals the number of candidate attempts, is at least three, and oracle_results covers every candidate attempt
tournament_checks.control: failed/stale/cancelled candidate omitted from the denominator

tournament_checks.asks: winner names a declared candidate and rationale is at least forty characters
tournament_checks.control: candidate self-report promoted without an exact-source readback

dag_checks.asks: every edge binds producer, produced_path, content_digest, consumer, consumed_digest, edge_type, reason and admission_receipt as non-empty strings
for every edge the consumer's depends_on contains the producer
dag_checks.control: false parallelism where implementation starts before the contract it consumes exists

dag_checks.asks: no node labelled SIBLING appears as the consumer of an edge
dag_checks.control: omitted dependency hidden by a sibling label

dag_checks.asks: exactly one CONVERGENCE node and its depends_on covers every other node
dag_checks.control: convergence before all required verified inputs

dag_checks.asks: every declared node has at least one attempt record
dag_checks.control: stale/cancelled attempt dropped from the record

rates.definition: fabricated_paths / cited_paths, where a cited path is fabricated unless it exists in the pinned consumer tree or its parent directory does
rates.null_when: no path was cited at all; a packet that cites nothing must not outrank one that cites ten and gets nine right

rubric.why_recorded_never_scored: cost and latency answer a different question from correctness. An arm that is cheaper while orchestrating worse has not won, so expense is reported beside the quality table and never folded into it.

power.verdict_floor: Below the minimum the verdict is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE whatever the numbers say. The observed per-check tallies are still published, labelled as the exercised mechanism and the observed direction, never as uplift.
power.why_a_floor: One paired observation per cell is a mechanism demonstration. Calling it a general uplift is the failure mode #316 names explicitly.

verdict_rule.B_DOMINATES: for every task shape, B's mean passed-check count is strictly greater than A's and B's path fabrication rate is not worse
verdict_rule.A_DOMINATES: the same condition with the arms exchanged
verdict_rule.NO_DETECTABLE_DIFFERENCE: every shape ties on both the passed-check count and the fabrication rate
verdict_rule.TRADEOFF: any other outcome at or above the minimum
verdict_rule.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: below the minimum, or any cell that did not return a scorable packet for a host reason

denominator_law: Every attempt is recorded, including cells that timed out, exited non-zero or returned nothing parseable. A HOST_ERROR cell stays in the denominator and is never re-run into silence; a re-run is a new attempt with its own row.
evidence_boundary: This establishes behavioral evidence only for these two bodies, this consumer subject, this model, this host and this repetition count.
Linked worktrees and physical Worker processes are closed deterministically by tests/real_task_ab.py, not by this lane; this lane runs one physical host process per cell and claims nothing more.
Provider adapters, Git Town, Forgejo, publication and GitHub Actions remain NOT_EXERCISED.
